attchmntText: Hero Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about link of Audio Recording of Conference Call with respect to Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Hero Motors Limited filed an audio recording of the conference call regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on November 16, 2026. This submission follows a previous letter dated November 11, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at https://www.heromotors.com/video/audio_recordings.mp3. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document was signed by Sakshi Dureja, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Hero Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
voiceSummary: Hero Motors Limited executed a Shareholders Agreement on 16th November 2026 with Hewland Engineering Limited, Mr. William Hewland, and Mrs. Siobhan Hewland. The agreement facilitates the acquisition of 8039 equity shares of Hewland Engineering Limited for approximately GBP 0.60 million. This transaction increases Hero Motors' stake in the subsidiary from 51% to 90%. The parties are not related to the promoter group, and the transaction is not a related party transaction. Under the agreement, Hero Motors has the right to nominate four directors to the board of Hewland Engineering Limited, including two additional directors. No new shares were issued as the company is acquiring existing shares from the current shareholders.

attchmntText: Hero Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Hero Motors Limited submitted a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company published these results in the Financial Express English newspaper and the Ludhiana edition of Daily Suraj Punjabi newspaper on November 16, 2026. The announcement confirms compliance with SEBI LODR regulations. Copies of the advertisements are enclosed with the filing. The information is also available on the company website at www.heromotors.com. The notice was signed by Sakshi Dureja, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, from Noida.

attchmntText: Hero Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Investor Presentation in connection with the un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter/half year ended on September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Hero Motors Limited filed an investor presentation with the BSE and NSE on November 16, 2026. The document covers un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation outlines the company's business mix, noting that powertrain business share rose from 20% in FY20 to approximately 54% in FY26. Overseas revenue accounted for 37% of total revenue in H1 FY27. Key developments include leasing a new 60,000 sq. ft facility in Bangalore for operations commencing by March or April 2027. The company reported a business pipeline valued at INR 4,076 crore. It also highlighted exclusive transmission supply for Formula 2, new marine application contracts, and design-to-cost programs for European and Indian automotive clients.

attchmntText: Hero Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
Hero Motors Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Hero Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Hero Motors Limited filed the Monitoring Agency report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of Rs. 600 crore IPO proceeds. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited and reviewed by the Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. The company parked Rs. 0.16 crore of unutilized proceeds in a Kotak Mahindra Bank Overdraft account, which deviates from the offer document. The monitoring agency classified this deviation as not material. During the quarter, Rs. 189.84 crore was utilized for repayment of borrowings, and Rs. 27 crore was spent on general corporate purposes. Unutilized proceeds of Rs. 383.16 crore remain, with Rs. 344.45 crore invested in fixed deposits.

attchmntText: Hero Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Hero Motors Limited has announced a conference call scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 16:00 hrs IST. The call will follow the submission of outcomes from the Board meeting on November 14, 2026. The discussion will cover Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company will be represented by Managing Director and CEO Mr. Amit Gupta and CFO Mr. Utkarsh Sanghi. Participants can join via universal access numbers or toll-free lines for Hong Kong, Singapore, UK, and USA. Registration is available through a provided link. Call coordinators include Mr. Vivek Kumar, Mr. Ronak Mehta, and Mr. Smit Shah from ICICI Securities. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Regulation 46 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
